title: A city of 100 windows
dek: Network El Segundo V2 turns the verified-wallet count into a nighttime civic signal wall
body:
Network El Segundo has opened a second living installation without replacing the first. V2 is a nighttime wall of one hundred public windows. Each unique Tezos Mainnet wallet verified through the free Kukai message flow lights one window, and the composition refreshes from the same deduplicated public count every thirty seconds.

Any visitor can touch a window to send a local visual pulse across the whole wall. That gesture changes only the browser animation; it does not change the roster, create a signature, identify a visitor, or write a transaction. The artwork receives the participant count and displays no wallet addresses.

The original First 100 Signal remains live as V1. PointCast carries 100 Windows through a distinct canonical route, this Block, JSON and RSS feeds, and a fourth creative in the reciprocal Network El Segundo house campaign. Joining still costs zero tez. No purchase, mint, token, transfer, payout, promised return, or automated distribution is active.
